item.text:
**Experimental Report**

Parent initial search used tool `web.run` with JSON keys: `search_query`, nested `q`, and `response_length`.

Parent search call shape:
```json
{
  "search_query": [
    {"q": "official Python website python.org"},
    {"q": "Mozilla products mozilla.org"}
  ],
  "response_length": "short"
}
```

Selected parent search refs:
- Python: `turn0search7` → `https://test.python.org/about/website/`
- Mozilla: `turn0search0` → `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/`

Subagents were spawned with `fork_context: false`, the available no-history equivalent. Both children ran before I opened either returned child source ref.

**Child Results**

Python child:
- First transferred-ref open: `{"open":[{"ref_id":"turn0search7"}],"response_length":"medium"}`
- Result: error, no page title/URL.
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn0search7","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Control open: `https://www.python.org/`
- Control result: worked, child page ref `turn1view0`
- Title/URL: `Welcome to Python.org (https://www.python.org/)`
- First numbered clickable link: source `turn1view0`, link ID `0`, label `▼ Close`

Mozilla child:
- First transferred-ref open: `open({"ref_id":"turn0search0","lineno":null})`
- Result: error, no real page title/URL.
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn0search0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Control open: `https://www.mozilla.org/`
- Control result: worked, child page ref `turn1view0`
- Title/URL: `Mozilla - Internet for people, not profit (US) (https://www.mozilla.org/)`
- Redirected URL: `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/`
- First numbered clickable link: source `turn1view0`, link ID `0`, label `Products`

**Parent Follow-Up Results**

Parent opened each child-reported source ref:

Python association:
- Parent `open` on child source `turn1view0`
- Returned parent error page ref: `turn0view0`
- Page title: `Internal Error`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn1view0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`

Mozilla association:
- Parent `open` on child source `turn1view0`
- Returned parent error page ref: `turn0view1`
- Page title: `Internal Error`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn1view0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`

Parent clicked each child-reported source ref/link ID:

Python association:
- Parent `click` on `turn1view0`, ID `0`
- Returned parent error page ref: `turn1view0`
- Page title: `Internal Error`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve click call: click({"ref_id":"turn1view0","id":0}) due to invalid arguments`

Mozilla association:
- Parent `click` on `turn1view0`, ID `0`
- Returned parent error page ref: `turn1view1`
- Page title: `Internal Error`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve click call: click({"ref_id":"turn1view0","id":0}) due to invalid arguments`

**Observed Collisions / Deviations**

- Child page refs collided: both fresh children independently reported control page ref `turn1view0`.
- Those child refs were not valid in the parent context.
- Protocol deviation: the available spawn API does not expose `fork_turns="none"` literally; I used `fork_context: false`.
- No shell commands, file edits, or contact attempts were used.
